description: ACKNOWLEDGES one or more incidents — this CHANGES live incident state (stops escalation and marks them as being worked on). Spike: POST /incidents/acknowledge with {ids:[...]}.

ids.description: Incident ids (the incident `_id` values) to acknowledge.

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

name: spike_acknowledge_incidents
title: Acknowledge incidents
